description: This file provides a utility function `safeJsonStringify` that serializes JavaScript values into JSON strings, handling special cases such as BigInt, functions, Error objects, and Uint8Array instances. It also gracefully returns null if serialization fails.

methods.name: export function safeJsonStringify(value: unknown): string | null { safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON string with custom handling for BigInt, functions, Error objects, and Uint8Array instances. Returns null if serialization fails.
